comments: Also available in German (https://ux.center/de/tools/kontrastrechner/) and Turkish (https://ux.center/tr/araclar/kontrast-hesaplayici/).
features: Free online color contrast checker for WCAG 2.2. Enter a text and background color (hex, rgb() or hsl()) to see the contrast ratio and pass/fail for AA and AAA, shown separately for normal text, large text and non-text UI components (3:1). It suggests the nearest passing shade and keeps both colors in a shareable URL. No account.
title: ux.center Color Contrast Checker
